name: PvE Power raises damage dealt to and lowers damage taken from creatures
contract: A chestpiece with PvE Power (+38) adds 38 x 0.05% = 1.9% to a level 60 player's damage against a creature and removes 1.9% from the damage that creature deals to the player, in the open world. Requires PvePower.Enable = 1 in coa.conf.

steps.label: Without PvE Power the player deals the base damage
Without PvE Power the creature deals the base damage
PvE Power +38 raises damage dealt to the creature by 1.9%
PvE Power +38 lowers damage taken from the creature by 1.9%
